subject: Next steps: POC activation playbook + model fallbacks for multilingual pipeline
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Rachelle O'Neil <rachelle.oneil@sunnovatech.com>, procurement@sunnovatech.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: POC activation playbook + model fallbacks for multilingual pipeline

Hi Rachelle — great to meet you and the Sunnova team today. Quick recap and an initial playbook attached so we can align on success criteria and owners before the kickoff.

TL;DR (asks):
- Confirm acceptance of the attached POC Activation Playbook (one-pager + timeline).
- Confirm languages to include in the POC: English, Spanish (US), and French (Canada).
- Accept our recommended primary and fallback model roster (see below) or tell us constraints.
- Procurement: we need contact for SOW signoff and any billing PO timelines.

POC scope (from call):
- Use case: claims-preamble extraction + customer-facing clarifying questions.
- Throughput target: 20 RPS sustained during peak tests; 50 ms median token latency target.
- Quality target: 92% slot extraction F1 on the 500-case eval set.

Initial model plan (recommendation):
- Primary: Llama-3-13B (8-bit quantized) tuned with domain prompts — chosen for best accuracy/latency mix.
- Fallback 1: Mistral-Instruct-7B (q4_k_m) — lower cost when latency SLO looms.
- Fallback 2: Llama-2-7B (fp16) — emergency lightweight path for burst capacity.

Why this roster: we want a high-quality primary for the evaulation window, plus two progressively cheaper/less-capable fallbacks that Redwood runtime can route to automatically based on latency/cost policies. We'll stage canary rollouts per model and keep an AB test to measure recall/precision delta.

Attachments included: POC_Activation_Playbook_v1.pdf (timeline + owners), Eval_Matrix_Sunnova.xlsx (initial test set and metrics).

Next steps / owners:
- Rachelle: confirm language list and legal/procurement contact (by Fri 6/18).
- Priyom: will own the eval matrix and release the 500-case seed set by Mon 6/21.
- Marissa: model onboarding, quantization config, and staging ship (blocks below).
- Avery: coordinate kickoff and runbook draft, schedule tech prep call for 6/22.

If that looks right I can lock the timeline and send a one-line SOW summary for procurement.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187

-----
Attachment: POC_Activation_Playbook_v1.pdf (11 pages; includes timeline, acceptance criteria, and rollback policy)
Attachment: Eval_Matrix_Sunnova.xlsx (sheet: eval_seed + scoring rubric)

From: Rachelle O'Neil <rachelle.oneil@sunnovatech.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@sunnovatech.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: POC activation playbook + model fallbacks for multilingual pipeline

Hi Avery — thanks for the write-up and the materials. Quick responses from our side:

- Languages: confirm English and Spanish. French (Canada) would be nice but let's treat it as stretch; include it in the eval set but not required for signoff.
- Procurement: procurement@sunnovatech.com (cc'd) is our billing contact — they need a 1-page SOW and an estimated monthly commit for the dedicated phase.
- Security/compliance: we will need an inventory of data retention rules and whether KV caches are persisted beyond session by default. Can someone from product/security send a short note?

On the model roster: the primary + fallbacks look fine. Our preference is to avoid LLMs that require additional licensing costs; can you confirm whether Llama-3-13B distribution here is covered under Redwood's hosted offering or requires customer license?

Last — can you push the kickoff to 6/23? We have a leadership offsite the 22nd.

Thanks,
Rachelle O'Neil
Director, Digital Operations
Sunnova HealthTech
rachelle.oneil@sunnovatech.com

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: POC activation playbook + model fallbacks for multilingual pipeline

Thanks Rachelle — short answers below and a few ops notes.

Licensing: Redwood hosts curated builds of Llama-3-13B as part of our verified catalog; there's no extra license fee on our hosted plan for the trial. If Sunnova wants to move to a private deployment (VPC / on-prem), we may need a separate model distribution agreement — I'll have Legal draft the language but that only impacts beyond the POC.

Security/data retention (answer):
- By default, prefix KV caches are ephemeral for hosted inference and retained only for the session lifecycle unless you enable longer-term cache for performance. We can provide an audit log for token-level retention on request.
- I'll share a short note (security checklist) for procurement with required SOC2 artifacts.

Model ops notes and suggested eval tweaks (from the infra team):
- Quantization profile: use 8-bit for Llama-3-13B during the eval window to meet the latency target; we'll run A/B against fp16 for quality samples.
- Batching: Redwood runtime will use micro-batching capped at 40ms to preserve median latency — we recommend running the 500-case stress test twice: once at steady 20 RPS, once with 3x burst.
- Language fallback: implement priority routing: English -> Spanish -> (optional) French. We recommend a simple confidence threshold for automatic fallback to Mistral-7B if the top candidate token-confidence falls below 0.62.

Ownership & timeline (concrete):
- Priyom (owner): seed eval set + upload to shared Drive by Mon 6/21.
- Marissa (owner): model builds + quant config deployed to sandbox by Tue 6/22.
- Avery (owner): schedule kickoff 6/23 + SOW summary for procurement by Thu 6/17.

I attached a pared-down eval matrix (Eval_Matrix_Sunnova.xlsx) and added two columns: cost_estimate_per_1k_tokens and fallback_delta_estimate. Priyom please confirm the seed cases.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
